name: Signal Amplifier - Flurry Strike
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. It can also enhance an ST's Flurry Strike and Gusty Strike.

61173.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Flurry Strike
61173.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
When launching Flurry Strike or Gusty Strike, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
